# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 3 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 3
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. For again he says to them concerning these things: "Why do you fast to me? says the Lord. Is it so your voice may be heard today in loud crying? This is not the fast I have chosen, says the Lord — that a man should humble himself.
2. Not even if you bow your neck as a ring and put on sackcloth and heap ashes under you — not even then shall you call it an acceptable fast."
3. But to us he says: "This is the fast I have chosen, says the Lord: Loose every bond of unrighteousness, untie the cords of violent oppression, release those who are broken and let them go free, and tear in pieces every unjust agreement.
4. Break your bread with the hungry, and if you see a naked person, clothe them; bring the homeless into your house, and if you see a person of lowly estate, do not despise them — neither you nor any of your household.
5. Then your light shall break forth early, and your healing shall arise quickly, and your righteousness shall go before you, and the glory of God shall encompass you.
6. Then shall you call, and God will hear you; and while you are still speaking he will say: 'Here I am.'"
7. So great a benefit it is, brothers, that the Lord has shown us these things and announced to us how we are to fast! He has declared what kind of fasting he has chosen. And the service of the Lord is sweet and glorious, bringing all things to us.
